scope: Local saved evidence only; no GPU/device queries or workloads. Earlier 325b/shared-KV comparisons remain a separate phase.

declared_build.note: Shared baseline is checkpoint cc3f50f; fixed-dimension source is identified by exact hashes. Model comment corrected without changing behavior.

prior_shared_build.note: Core is checkpoint 63290a5; selected source is identified by exact hashes.

identity.note: The probe and application build are identified separately. Shader hashes must match; a different final binary is not silently attributed probe-wide identity. Fresh application validation establishes the final binary's evidence.

declared.scope: CPU-only GLSL/SPIR-V checks; no GPU execution or numerical/performance claim

probe.note: Means average two GPUs and two equal-iteration repetitions. Payload/cache micro results do not establish application gains. Scalar controls are separate.

validation.note: Pass evidence parsed from the full validation log, including unfiltered CPU test counts. No separate validation-process exit/window file is emitted by the driver.
